process_model: each session is an independent spawned process (fresh Python allocator, JIT cache, and runtime state); the parent gates freshness once, every worker re-gates before any launch
protocol: 3 independent process sessions, 30 interleaved steady trials each (random cell order per trial, seeded), explicit synchronize around every timed call. HybridPlans are re-constructed per session so twiddle/staging/row caches are cold at session start; first call per cell pays JIT and is correctness-gated before warmup. Statistics: pooled and per-session p50 / MAD / p95 / max / outlier count (outliers > p50+3*MAD); every outlier value is listed. A confirmation session is added automatically when the A1P1-vs-vendor guard passes in the protocol sessions. Guard evaluation uses the 2% threshold against A0P0 (in-table incumbent) and vendor_full, on protocol-session pooled medians. A1P1 is an experimental canary: even a guard pass does not promote it into the selector table (cost model has no A1 family).
